title: [AAPS 2.7.0] -> temp target finish: target stuck on selected value with green background
symptom: After a temp target finishes, the target remains stuck on the temp target value (e.g., 160) with a green background instead of reverting to the profile target (e.g., 100). This occurs after sports when the profile has been changed and a temp target was set. The issue is intermittent and may be related to communication loss with the pump.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user suggests it may be caused by communication loss with the DanaRS pump at the end of the temp target time, causing the temp target to remain stuck until communication is successful. Another user notes it may be a cosmetic bug that resolves after a few minutes. A maintainer indicates it is a 2.7 feature and that the target stays green until the next OAPS run without TT adjustment.
fix: No explicit fix is provided. One user resolved it by restarting the phone. The maintainer implies no change is required as it is a feature, and the target will update on the next OAPS run.
evidence_quote: I've seen similar, but for me it is caused by communication lost with the DanaRS pump at the end of the temp target time. When this happens, the temp target remains 'stuck', as in your screen shot, until communication with the pump is successful.
